title: Neferine ameliorates psoriasis through inducing oxidative stress-mediated keratinocyte apoptosis and suppressing inflammatory response via the Keap1-Nrf2 pathway.
authors: Cheng, Baochen; Zhang, Zhengyi; Bai, Ruimin; Du, Wenqian; Le, Hao; He, Ke; Yin, Tingyi; Wang, Ziyang; Liu, Xinyi; Liu, Jiankang; Zheng, Yan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然小分子Neferine通过Keap1-Nrf2通路治疗银屑病，核心为蛋白-小分子互作与细胞凋亡，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Psoriasis is a chronic inflammatory skin disease characterized by keratinocytes (KCs) hyperproliferation and persistent inflammation. Current biologics are limited by high relapse rates and long-term safety concerns, prompting the search for multi-target natural small molecules. A murine psoriasis model was induced by 6-day continuous topical imiquimod (IMQ) application; cellular models were established by stimulating keratinocyte lines with tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha)/interleukin-17A (IL-17A). Network pharmacology and molecular docking were employed to predict targets, and small interfering RNA targeting Nrf2(siNrf2) was used for mechanistic validation. Neferine administration significantly attenuated epidermal hyperplasia, splenomegaly and cutaneous inflammation in vivo. In KCs, Neferine dose-dependently suppressed inflammatory cytokines and pathway proteins, elevated oxidative stress levels, decreased mitochondrial membrane potential (DeltaPsim) and promoted apoptosis. Neferine bound Keap1, reduced its level, enhanced Nrf2 nuclear translocation and up-regulated HO-1/NQO1. siNrf2 abolished Nef-mediated inhibition of NF-kappaB/ERK phosphorylation, cytokine down-regulation and DeltaPsim loss. Neferine ameliorates psoriasis by inducing oxidative stress-driven apoptosis in hyper-proliferative keratinocytes and by activating Keap1-Nrf2-mediated anti-inflammatory signaling to block the IL-23/IL-17 axis, offering a promising small-molecule strategy for psoriasis management.
abstract_zh: 银屑病是一种以角质形成细胞（KCs）过度增殖和持续炎症为特征的慢性炎症性皮肤病。当前生物制剂受限于高复发率和长期安全性问题，促使研究者寻找多靶点天然小分子。通过连续6天局部涂抹咪喹莫特（IMQ）诱导小鼠银屑病模型；通过用肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）/白细胞介素-17A（IL-17A）刺激角质形成细胞系建立细胞模型。采用网络药理学和分子对接预测靶点，并使用靶向Nrf2的小干扰RNA（siNrf2）进行机制验证。Neferine给药显著减轻了体内表皮增生、脾肿大和皮肤炎症。在KCs中，Neferine剂量依赖性地抑制炎症细胞因子和通路蛋白，升高氧化应激水平，降低线粒体膜电位（ΔΨm）并促进凋亡。Neferine结合Keap1，降低其水平，增强Nrf2核转位并上调HO-1/NQO1。siNrf2消除了Nef介导的NF-κB/ERK磷酸化抑制、细胞因子下调和ΔΨm丧失。Neferine通过诱导过度增殖角质形成细胞中氧化应激驱动的凋亡，并激活Keap1-Nrf2介导的抗炎信号以阻断IL-23/IL-17轴，从而改善银屑病，为银屑病管理提供了一种有前景的小分子策略。
